config system interface
    edit "_default"
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 1
    next
    edit "quarantine"
        set ip 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4093
    next
    edit "voice"
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4091
    next
    edit "video"
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4090
    next
    edit "rspan"
        set ip 192.0.2.2 255.255.255.0
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4092
    next
    edit "onboarding"
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4089
    next
    edit "nac_segment"
        set ip 192.0.2.3 255.255.255.0
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4088
    next
    edit "ap-mgmt"
        set ip 192.0.2.4 255.255.255.0
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 100
    next
end
